issue: Cross-chapter inconsistency in arithmetic basis for MoE active weight read traffic. Ch. 3 consistently calculates the active weight read (~25.6 GB) using a 'component-derived' total of ~47B (implying ~1.4B always-on + ~45.6B experts), whereas the vendor-published Mixtral 8x7B configuration used for the KV cache calculation in the same chapter (32 layers, hidden 4096) implies a much smaller always-on block (~0.7B). If the vendor-spec geometry were applied to the weight read, the active traffic would be ~24.2 GB, not 25.6 GB. Ch. 3 mixes a '47B total' (which requires a larger embedding/projection layer than the 4096-hidden config supports) with a '4096-hidden' attention geometry, creating a phantom discrepancy in the active weight read baseline. The 'canonical' dense 70B uses a constructed geometry (8192 hidden) that is explicitly labeled as teaching, but the MoE example conflates the published 46.7B/12.9B totals with the published 4096-hidden config without reconciling the implied always-on size.
fix_instruction: Explicitly state in the caption or Table 3-2 derivation that the ~25.6 GB active weight read is derived from the component-split (~1.4B always-on) required to reach the ~47B total, and note that this ~1.4B assumption is inconsistent with the published 4096-hidden architecture (which would imply ~0.7B always-on and ~24.2 GB active read). Flag this as a known modeling simplification in the 'Worked example, not reference' header.
